$comment: Settings of pipeline:flow-water (F2), the offline Python step that derives a water network per flow section from Sentinel-2 L2A and Copernicus GLO-30 (pipeline/py). crs: the metric grid of every section (UTM 19S covers the Río Negro basin); resolutionM: grid cell, the Sentinel-2 native 10 m (the SWIR band is 20 m native, so the MNDWI edge is effectively 20 m). corridorM: buffer (m) of the section's IGN course (public/flow/<id>/<section>.json stations) that defines the area of interest; the grid is its bounding box snapped outward to resolutionM. stac: url and collection of the Element84 Earth Search STAC (public, no key); datetime is the search interval (Jan-Apr 2024: low water and clear summer, the year of the EOX 2024 basemap); maxCloudPct keeps scenes with eo:cloud_cover below it; looks is how many acquisition dates are pinned per section (scenes of the same date are mosaicked; ranked by mean cloud cover, then date). The pinned scenes are written to data/work/<id>/flow-water/cache/<section>/scenes.lock.json and reused until --reselect. dem: urlTemplate of the GLO-30 COG tiles on AWS Open Data, one per degree, named by the floor of the latitude and longitude of the tile corner ({lat} like S39, {lon} like W069). All values are provisional until the first report is read.

water.$comment: Water mask of F2.2. Per look: water = SCL in sclValid (0 no data, 1 saturated, 3 cloud shadow, 8/9 cloud, 10 cirrus, 11 snow are dropped; 2 dark area and 7 unclassified are kept because dark deep water and turbid water land there) and MNDWI = (green-swir16)/(green+swir16) > mndwiMin and NDVI = (nir-red)/(nir+red) < ndviMax. A pixel is water when its water frequency over the valid looks is >= minFreq with at least minValidLooks valid looks. closingPx: side of the square binary closing (padded so the AOI border is not eroded). minIslandM2: enclosed non-water holes (islands, bars) smaller than this are filled; also the smallest ring kept in reservoir polygons. keepCorridorM: only 8-connected water components that touch the course buffered by this are kept. Provisional until the first report is read.

reservoir.$comment: Reservoir zones of F2.2: the morphological opening of the water mask by a disk of radius minHalfWidthM (every water pixel covered by a disk of that radius lying fully in water, so a river narrower than twice this is never a reservoir). Zone components under minAreaKm2 are dropped (they stay channel). simplifyM: Douglas-Peucker tolerance (m) of the polygons, topology preserved.
